evals.prompt: I need to see how much we're spending on LLM tokens per model over the last 2 weeks, broken down daily. Also show me which model has the worst latency P99.
evals.expected_output: Two validated NRQL queries: one with TIMESERIES 1 day showing tokens per model, another showing P99 latency per model. Both scoped to My_Zodiac_AI_prod app, using LlmChatCompletionSummary event type with backtick-quoted attributes.
expectations: Output contains a NRQL query using LlmChatCompletionSummary event type
Token query includes TIMESERIES and FACET by model
P99 query uses percentile(duration, 99) or similar
Queries were validated via run_nrql_query MCP tool

evals.prompt: Create a dashboard for monitoring our MongoDB performance — I want to see slow queries, connection pool health, and command breakdown. Export the JSON so I can import it.
evals.expected_output: A NerdGraph-compatible dashboard JSON file with widgets covering: slow query table, connection pool line chart, command breakdown bar chart. Billboard KPIs at top. Grid positions don't overlap. Account ID 7715788.
expectations: Output includes a saved JSON file with valid NerdGraph dashboard structure
Dashboard JSON contains accountId 7715788 in nrqlQueries
Dashboard has widgets for slow queries (table visualization)
Dashboard has widgets for connection pool (line or area visualization)
Dashboard has widgets for command breakdown (bar visualization)
Widget grid positions use column/row/width/height and fit within 12-column grid
At least one billboard widget with thresholds is present

evals.prompt: Set up SLI/SLO monitoring for our API availability. Target 99.9% over 30 days. I want an error budget tracker and a burn-rate chart.
evals.expected_output: SLI definition with availability ratio query, error budget calculation NRQL, burn-rate timeseries NRQL. Dashboard page or JSON with billboard for current SLI %, billboard for error budget remaining, line chart for SLI over time, line chart for burn rate.
expectations: Output defines an SLI using httpResponseCode < 500 as good events
Error budget calculation uses (1 - 0.999) as the budget factor
A burn-rate or SLI-over-time query uses TIMESERIES
Output includes a dashboard JSON or structured dashboard page definition
SLO target of 99.9% is clearly stated in the output
